title: Finance & Controlling Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
📊 Wie profitabel ist ein Event wirklich, und wohin entwickeln sich unsere Zahlen in den nächsten Monaten? Bei Dreamlight Labs findest du es heraus. Wir suchen eine zahlenstarke Persönlichkeit, die unsere Finanzen und das Controlling übernimmt und zur Expert:in für alles wird, was bei uns mit Geld zu tun hat.
 Du willst in einem wachsenden Start-up Verantwortung für die Zahlen übernehmen und neue Strukturen aufbauen? Wir freuen uns auf dich! 🎉
 Deine Aufgaben als Finance & Controlling Manager:in Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich unser Controlling und unsere Finanzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit der Geschäftsführung aus und bringst Struktur in einen businesskritischen Bereich.
 Monatliches Controlling und Forecast: Zahlen auswerten, Abweichungen erkennen und Forecasts laufend aktualisieren
 Kostenüberblick: u.a. Event-, Personal- und Marketingkosten steuern, inklusive Marketingabgrenzung und Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung
 Eventkalkulation: verstehen und weiterentwickeln
 Finanzbuchhaltung: Basics sicher abdecken, dazu Intercompany und Quellensteuern
 Struktur schaffen: Tabellen und internes Finanz-Tool verstehen, eigene Prozesse aufbauen
 Reporting: Zahlen für die Geschäftsführung aufbereiten und Handlungsbedarf erkennen
 Das bringst du mit 2–3 Jahre Vollzeiterfahrung in Finance, Controlling, Buchhaltung oder Steuerberatung
 Sicherer Umgang mit Kennzahlen, Forecasts sowie Kenntnisse in der Finanzbuchhaltung
 Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du findest dich in bestehende Systeme rasch ein
 Du denkst weiter und siehst, wohin die Zahlen uns führen können
 Start-up-Mentalität: Du hast schon in kleineren Unternehmen gearbeitet, packst pragmatisch an und behältst auch mit wenig Struktur den Überblick
 Nice to have: KI-Affinität, Erfahrung in der Eventbranche oder internationalen Steuerrecht
 Das bieten wir dir Viel Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst den Bereich Finanzen und Controlling
 Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und echter Einfluss auf unsere Entscheidungen

title: Senior Application Security Analyst
description:
D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift.
 New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.
 D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.
 D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.
 Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.
 As Senior Application Security Analyst at D2L, you are a key influencer and contributor to the refinement and delivery of D2L's Application Security Program.
 How will I make an Impact?
 Assist in refining and delivering D2L's Application Security Program with particular focus on endpoints, applications, and the underlying infrastructure.
 Collaborate with operational teams on existing and emerging security risks and provide subject matter expertise.
 Perform regular security scans and coordinate with stakeholders to address open issues
 Triage third-party assessments and follow up with stakeholders to address issues

title: Staff Product Manager, Marketing Automation - CANADA
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.
 Role Overview
 We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own a core part of how our clients market themselves: the websites, content, and campaigns that get them found, keep them top of mind, and turn attention into business. Our clients are real estate professionals, many of them top producers in luxury markets, and they count on us for the marketing they don't have time to do themselves.
 Generating marketing content is easy now. Generating content a top agent is proud to put their name on is not. That bar, across every channel our clients use, is the game we're in. So is proving what works: showing clients how their channels feed each other and which ones are actually driving business.
 This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with close collaboration across engineering, design, AI/ML, client success, and sales. You'll own a product area end to end, set its strategy, and grow its scope as we expand into new channels.
 What You'll Do
 Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for a set of AI-powered marketing products, starting with how our clients get discovered and the content we create for them
 Make sure our clients get found, whether a prospective buyer or seller searches on Google or asks an AI assistant who to call
 Raise the quality bar on everything we create on our clients' behalf, so it sounds like them and reflects the brand they've built
 Design how channels work together, so a client's website, content, email, and social reinforce each other instead of running as separate tools

title: Director of Pricing and Packaging
description:
Role Description
 As Director of Pricing and Packaging at Dropbox , you will lead the strategy that determines how we package, price, and monetize our products across product-led growth (PLG) and sales-led growth (SLG) motions. Reporting to Head of Product Marketing, you will lead a small team and partner closely with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and senior executives to make pricing and packaging a durable driver of customer value and profitable growth.
 This is a highly visible opportunity to help reinvent Dropbox’s monetization approach as we expand our sales-led business and build for the AI era. You will develop a holistic pricing and packaging architecture across products, customer segments, and routes to market—balancing customer adoption, competitive positioning, revenue growth, cost to serve, and margin. You will translate complex analysis into clear strategic choices, build alignment among senior leaders, and establish the capabilities and operating rhythms needed to make consistently strong monetization decisions.
 You will have significant exposure to Dropbox’s senior leadership team and the opportunity to shape some of the company’s most consequential growth decisions. Your work will directly influence how customers experience and value Dropbox, how our products go to market, and how the business grows over the long term.
 Responsibilities
 Define and lead Dropbox’s company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across PLG and SLG motions, customer segments, product portfolios, and geographies.
 Design the next generation of Dropbox’s packaging and monetization architecture, including approaches for AI-powered products and capabilities, while balancing customer value, adoption, revenue, cost to serve, and margin.

title: Deal Desk Specialist
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry
 At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
 Why this role is on the menu
 Instacart's Sales organization is at an inflection point. New products, pricing models, and acquisitions are making every deal more complex, and the processes behind them need to scale just as fast. We're hiring a Deal Desk Specialist to make every deal fast, well-structured, and compliant, so Sales can close with confidence and Finance, Tax, and Legal can trust what gets booked. This role sits at the intersection of Sales and Finance, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to deal velocity, revenue quality, and the health of our Quote-to-Cash process.
 What you'll cook up in your first year
 Deal Velocity: Deals move from quote to close without friction. Pricing, discounting, and structure are reviewed and approved quickly and correctly, so Sales spends its time selling instead of chasing approvals.
